:::{#exr-solve-normal-equations-vector}
#### Solving the normal equations in vector notation

Assuming $S_{xx} > 0$ (@def-centered-sums),
show that $A$ from @exr-normal-equations-vector is invertible,
solve $A \vcoef = \v{c}$ for $\vcoef$,
and compare the result with @exr-solve-normal-equations.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-solve-normal-equations-vector}

Write out the entries of each term of $A$ and $\v{c}$, then add them up:

$$
\begin{aligned}
A
&= \sumin \soprod{\vxi}
&& \text{(definition of $A$)}\\
&= \sumin \begin{pmatrix} 1 & \predvar_\iobs \\ \predvar_\iobs & \predvar_\iobs^2 \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(outer product of $\vxi$)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix} \sumin 1 & \sumin \predvar_\iobs \\ \sumin \predvar_\iobs & \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(matrices add entrywise)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix} n & \sumin \predvar_\iobs \\ \sumin \predvar_\iobs & \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(sum of a constant)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix} n & n\bar{x} \\ n\bar{x} & \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs = n \bar{x}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
\v{c}
&= \sumin \vxi \outvar_\iobs
&& \text{(definition of $\v{c}$)}\\
&= \sumin \begin{pmatrix} \outvar_\iobs \\ \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(scalar times a vector)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix} \sumin \outvar_\iobs \\ \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(vectors add entrywise)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix} n\bar{y} \\ \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{($\sumin \outvar_\iobs = n \bar{y}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The determinant of $A$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\det A
&= n \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - \paren{n\bar{x}} \paren{n\bar{x}}
&& \text{(determinant of a $2 \times 2$ matrix)}\\
&= n \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - n^2 \bar{x}^2
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= n \paren{\sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - n \bar{x}^2}
&& \text{(factor out $n$)}\\
&= n S_{xx}
&& \text{(expansion of $S_{xx}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

where the last step uses @exr-sxx-expand.
Since $n > 0$ and $S_{xx} > 0$, $\det A > 0$,
so $A$ is invertible,
and $A \vcoef = \v{c}$ has exactly one solution, $A^{-1} \v{c}$.

To simplify $A^{-1} \v{c}$, we need two expansions of uncentered sums.
Adding $n \bar{x}^2$ to both sides of @exr-sxx-expand gives
$\sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 = S_{xx} + n \bar{x}^2$.
The cross-product sum expands the same way:

$$
\begin{aligned}
S_{xy}
&= \sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \bar{x})(\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y})
&& \text{(definition of $S_{xy}$)}\\
&= \sumin \paren{\predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \predvar_\iobs \bar{y} - \bar{x} \outvar_\iobs + \bar{x} \bar{y}}
&& \text{(expand the product)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \sumin \predvar_\iobs \bar{y} - \sumin \bar{x} \outvar_\iobs + \sumin \bar{x} \bar{y}
&& \text{(sum of a sum)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \bar{y} \sumin \predvar_\iobs - \sumin \bar{x} \outvar_\iobs + \sumin \bar{x} \bar{y}
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \bar{y} \sumin \predvar_\iobs - \bar{x} \sumin \outvar_\iobs + \sumin \bar{x} \bar{y}
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \bar{y} \sumin \predvar_\iobs - \bar{x} \sumin \outvar_\iobs + n \bar{x} \bar{y}
&& \text{(sum of a constant)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \bar{y} \paren{n \bar{x}} - \bar{x} \sumin \outvar_\iobs + n \bar{x} \bar{y}
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs = n \bar{x}$)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \bar{y} \paren{n \bar{x}} - \bar{x} \paren{n \bar{y}} + n \bar{x} \bar{y}
&& \text{($\sumin \outvar_\iobs = n \bar{y}$)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - n \bar{x} \bar{y} - n \bar{x} \bar{y} + n \bar{x} \bar{y}
&& \text{(reorder the factors)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - n \bar{x} \bar{y}
&& \text{(combine like terms)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Adding $n \bar{x} \bar{y}$ to both sides gives
$\sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs = S_{xy} + n \bar{x} \bar{y}$.
Now compute the solution:

$$
\begin{aligned}
A^{-1} \v{c}
&= \frac{1}{\det A}
  \begin{pmatrix} \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 & -n\bar{x} \\ -n\bar{x} & n \end{pmatrix}
  \v{c}
&& \text{(inverse of a $2 \times 2$ matrix)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix} \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 & -n\bar{x} \\ -n\bar{x} & n \end{pmatrix}
  \v{c}
&& \text{($\det A = n S_{xx}$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix} \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 & -n\bar{x} \\ -n\bar{x} & n \end{pmatrix}
  \begin{pmatrix} n\bar{y} \\ \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(substitute $\v{c}$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 \cdot n\bar{y} + \paren{-n\bar{x}} \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \\
  \paren{-n\bar{x}} \cdot n\bar{y} + n \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(matrix times a vector)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  n \bar{y} \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - n \bar{x} \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \\
  -n^2 \bar{x} \bar{y} + n \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(multiply out the products)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n S_{xx}} \, n
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \bar{y} \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - \bar{x} \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \\
  -n \bar{x} \bar{y} + \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(factor $n$ out of the vector)}\\
&= \frac{1}{S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \bar{y} \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - \bar{x} \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \\
  -n \bar{x} \bar{y} + \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(cancel $n$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \bar{y} \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - \bar{x} \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \\
  \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - n \bar{x} \bar{y}
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(reorder the terms of the second entry)}\\
&= \frac{1}{S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \bar{y} \paren{S_{xx} + n\bar{x}^2} - \bar{x} \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \\
  \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - n \bar{x} \bar{y}
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 = S_{xx} + n\bar{x}^2$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \bar{y} \paren{S_{xx} + n\bar{x}^2} - \bar{x} \paren{S_{xy} + n\bar{x}\bar{y}} \\
  \paren{S_{xy} + n\bar{x}\bar{y}} - n \bar{x} \bar{y}
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs = S_{xy} + n\bar{x}\bar{y}$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \bar{y} S_{xx} + \bar{y} n\bar{x}^2 - \bar{x} S_{xy} - \bar{x} n\bar{x}\bar{y} \\
  S_{xy} + n\bar{x}\bar{y} - n \bar{x} \bar{y}
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(distribute)}\\
&= \frac{1}{S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \bar{y} S_{xx} + n\bar{x}^2\bar{y} - \bar{x} S_{xy} - n\bar{x}\bar{x}\bar{y} \\
  S_{xy} + n\bar{x}\bar{y} - n \bar{x} \bar{y}
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(reorder the factors)}\\
&= \frac{1}{S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \bar{y} S_{xx} + n\bar{x}^2\bar{y} - \bar{x} S_{xy} - n\bar{x}^2\bar{y} \\
  S_{xy} + n\bar{x}\bar{y} - n \bar{x} \bar{y}
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{($\bar{x} \bar{x} = \bar{x}^2$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \bar{y} S_{xx} - \bar{x} S_{xy} \\
  S_{xy} + n\bar{x}\bar{y} - n \bar{x} \bar{y}
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(first entry: cancel $\pm n\bar{x}^2\bar{y}$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{S_{xx}}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \bar{y} S_{xx} - \bar{x} S_{xy} \\
  S_{xy}
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(second entry: cancel $\pm n\bar{x}\bar{y}$)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix}
  \bar{y} S_{xx} / S_{xx} - \bar{x} \, S_{xy} / S_{xx} \\
  S_{xy} / S_{xx}
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(multiply each entry by $1 / S_{xx}$)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix}
  \bar{y} - \bar{x} \, S_{xy} / S_{xx} \\
  S_{xy} / S_{xx}
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(cancel $S_{xx}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Its entries are $\intcoef = \bar{y} - \coef{x} \bar{x}$ and $\coef{x} = S_{xy} / S_{xx}$,
the same solution as @exr-solve-normal-equations.

:::
